|game_text=Deploy on [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One{{!}}The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]; treat "4" on it as "2." Your Force generation at [[Tatooine: City Outskirts{{!}}City Outskirts]] is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. |errata_history=This is the original printed text; the images are the release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB8-p4-74-A_Remote_Planet.png]]) and the Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-L-aremoteplanet-pre.gif]]). The later errata version is [[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text).
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet (official text as of 14 September 2012; the slip and the Players Committee card image print it)<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock8_2">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Virtual Block 8.2 release sheet] ("Official text as of September 14, 2012"; the surviving copy was re-made 18 October 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>: “Deploy on [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One{{!}}The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]; treat "4" on it as "2." Your Force generation at [[Tatooine: City Outskirts{{!}}City Outskirts]] is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. Once per game, may ▼ Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan (and/or their matching weapon). [Immune to Alter]” The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Light Side p. 21)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> prints this text again; that copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The same text was shown earlier as one of the four Virtual Block 8.2 preview cards (posted 14 July 2012, legal from 26 July 2012)<ref name="pc-news-82preview">Players Committee news post “v8.2 Preview Spoiler List”, 14 July 2012 (“spoiled cards are always subject to change prior to release”), on the News page as captured 18 August 2012: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120818111414/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/index.php?option=com_content&view=category&layout=blog&id=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[A Remote Planet (V) (Virtual Block 8) (Errata)]]): the PC website card list (shown from 12 December 2012, the first archived capture with Virtual Block 8.2 text, to 11 January 2013) writes “Gone: treat '4' on it as '2'.” and “(an/or their matching weapon_” (typos as published). PC-E1 text<ref name="cl-1282_20">Players Committee website card list (VBlock8Type, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20121212003733/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2012-12-12], [https://web.archive.org/web/20130111142925/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock8Type.html 2013-01-11]; the same text in the VBlock8Name / VBlock8Rarity list) (Internet Archive)</ref>: “Deploy on [[The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One{{!}}The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone]]: treat "4" on it as "2". Your Force generation at [[Tatooine: City Outskirts{{!}}City Outskirts]] is +1. May deploy systems regardless of your Objective deployment restrictions. Once per game, may ▼ Qui-Gon or Obi-Wan (an/or their matching weapon_. [Immune to Alter]” The card list drops icons; the icons here are those of the printed slip. Card-list differences are versions (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026). The card list writes quotations in single quotes (its HTML cannot hold double quotes); double quotes are used here, with the card list's punctuation.
